title: SynapSys Governed Object/Relationship Adapter Contract v0.2 (SCVS-extended)
description: Additive extension of the Lane B v0.1 contract (lane-b-n8n-viewer-canvas-compiler/schema/graph_schema.json, UNCHANGED and still valid on its own). Every v0.1-valid graph is also v0.2-valid: nothing required in v0.1 was removed or made stricter except the return_route no-arrow rule, which v0.1 already carries (Correction v0.1). v0.2 adds four OPTIONAL per-object fields so the SCVS v0.2.1 visual standard (source tag, owner-lane bracket, per-object evidence/PPV chips) can be rendered without inventing data: an object that omits them falls back to the view-level evidence/ppv and an 'unspecified' owner/source tag, rather than failing.

return_route.description: Single stable path/URL to the candidate Architecture v1.3 (or, for objects that must reference the CURRENT surface, v1.2) — never two segments joined by an arrow.

evidence.description: OPTIONAL per-object evidence chip (SCVS §2.1). Falls back to the view's evidence field when absent.

ppv.description: OPTIONAL per-object PPV chip. Falls back to the view's ppv field when absent. 'Verified' should only be used when authority names a quoted Steward/D001 record.

owner_lane.description: OPTIONAL bracket tag, e.g. '[D001]', '[Codex]', '[CoWork]', '[Steward]'. Omitted renders no owner-lane chip.

source_tag.description: OPTIONAL corner source tag per SCVS §2.1. Omitted renders no corner tag.

stop_hold.description: OPTIONAL. When present, this object renders the SCVS STOP/HOLD frame + ⚠ banner naming the holder, e.g. 'D001 decision pending'.

line_style.description: OPTIONAL, SCVS §2.2 line semantics: solid=operational flow, dashed=read-only projection ('does not authorise' edges are always verb-labelled as such), dotted=proposed. Defaults to 'operational' when absent.
